title: SoundFX
description: SoundFX adds new custom sound effects in Minecraft
body:
It is a texture pack that adds various custom sounds to the Minecraft game 


## How do I add the sounds?
To play sounds, you really should use the /playsound command that comes built into vanilla Minecraft

**Example:**

```
/playsound minecraft:custom.explosion master @a
```
- You must use the **custom.** prefix.

## list of all sounds

```
minecraft:custom.bruh
minecraft:custom.elevator_music
minecraft:custom.explosion
minecraft:custom.internet_low
minecraft:custom.jump
minecraft:custom.shoot
```
